title: Sonni24 buying guide: shower glass, LED mirrors, radiators
deck: Choose Sonni24 fixtures for Germany/EU in EUR with our measurement and installation checks, verified November 26, 2026. Plan before you order.
tldr: Measure the finished opening before choosing shower glass. Decide between a flat LED mirror and a recessed storage cabinet before preparing the wall. Treat the towel radiator's conflicting electric/hot-water descriptions as a question to resolve before payment. These are German-storefront EUR observations, not a US shopping list or a hands-on ranking.
heroAlt: Sonni24 walk-in shower glass, GLM04XL LED mirror, three-door mirror cabinet and white towel radiator

blocks.title: Research, not an installation review
blocks.text: This guide uses official German product data and policies checked November 26, 2026. Duyan did not install or wire these fixtures, measure glass flatness, test water tightness or verify heating output. Prices and stock are dated observations. Buy buttons and official source links carry our referral code; purchases may earn us a commission. Our [methodology](/methodology) explains that evidence standard. This is Germany/EU-focused planning, not a US domestic-store guide. Delivery beyond Germany needs confirmation.

This Sonni24 buying guide starts with the wall, not the photograph. Sonni Sanitär GmbH, the Hilden seller named in the Impressum, offers shower glass, mirrors, storage and radiators. Dimensions alone do not establish fit: glass needs adjustment clearance, a cabinet may need a recess, and a radiator needs a confirmed heat source.

Cover image: walk-in glass from the GWRH range, GLM04XL LED mirror, GTBC001T-1 three-door cabinet and white 500×1314mm radiator, composited from official photographs under owner-reported authorization. It is not our product shoot, a fitted bathroom, a bundle or a scale comparison. The glass photograph represents multiple widths; the corner enclosure is not pictured.
The short version

items: For an open shower entrance, consider the 8mm **Walk-In Duschwand**. For a closing corner entrance, compare the 5mm **Duschkabine Eckeinstieg**. Neither is a complete waterproofed shower project.

For reflection and light, choose the flat **LED Badspiegel**. For storage, consider the three-door **LED Spiegelschrank**, but its current description requires recessed installation, not ordinary surface hanging.

For towel warming, inspect the **Badheizkörper** listing closely. Its electric headline conflicts with hot-water specifications. Confirm the exact element, valves and connection requirements before buying.

blocks.text: Check region, measurements and installation first

items: **Region and language:** the storefront and contract language are German. Manual and support languages were not verified; confirm them before ordering. Germany is documented; other EU destinations need address-specific confirmation. A country selector is not delivery approval. This is not a US domestic store.

**Currency and tax:** all amounts are EUR. The captured price blocks do not establish German statutory VAT/MwSt. inclusion; confirm the invoice and delivered total. A VAT registration number is not a tax-inclusion statement. Prices and promotions can change without notice.

**Glass fit:** measure finished tiled surfaces at several heights, both sides of a corner and the intended entrance clearance. Verstellbereich means profile adjustment range, not spare glass width. The selected partition allows 15mm inward adjustment; the corner profiles allow 20mm. Ask the installer to assess any out-of-plumb walls.

**Glass and groundwork:** ESG means single-pane toughened safety glass. Do not assume a 6mm search filter matches everything: these picks specify 8mm and 5mm. Ohne Duschtasse means without a shower tray. Budget for a compatible tray or prepared floor, drain, waterproofing and sealing; confirm supplied parts.

**Wall preparation:** check substrate and fixings for the glass stabilizer, mirror, loaded cabinet and filled radiator. The cabinet needs a suitable wall opening. Product dimensions are not recess-cutting dimensions, and the cached text does not establish fixing-load ratings. Check for hidden pipes and cables before drilling.

**Electrical and heating:** plan around European 230V supplies and local bathroom wet-zone rules, not 120V US wiring. IP44 is published for both mirror products, but it does not approve every position. Exact SKU input ratings and plug-versus-hardwire arrangements were not verified. Have a qualified electrician/plumber confirm the manual, circuit and heating connections where local code requires.

**Freight and reversal cost:** confirm parcel versus Spedition freight, the ground-floor delivery limit and return collection costs before paying. The shipping pages disagree on fees, while the refund policy gives a 14-day withdrawal window. Keep packaging until glass, doors and hardware have been inspected.

blocks.text: Record the variant, installed dimensions, missing parts and trade costs together. Our [practical buying guides](/guides) settle prerequisites before features. Browse [Tech coverage](/tech) for related equipment decisions, not bathroom electrical approval.
Five fixtures for five different jobs

All five selected variants had available=true in saved HTML and Shopify JSON, matching displayed EUR prices and enabled cart buttons on November 26, 2026. Stock is not reserved. CTAs open the storefront because product-level attribution is unverified. Search the German term and SKU, then choose the stated size; prices differ by configuration.

blocks.name: SONNI Walk-In Duschwand, 70cm / 8mm
blocks.blurb: Choose 70cm / 8mm, SKU GWR70H, for a fixed partition rather than a closing enclosure. Its displayed price was €149.99 EUR on November 26, 2026, with stock available in both saved variant records. The page specifies clear Klarglas, 200cm height, 8mm ESG with Nano coating, a chrome-finish aluminium profile and included 100cm stainless stabilizer bar. Its installed-width range is 685–700mm, including the profile. The description allows left/right mounting and shortening the stabilizer to suit. The trade-off is an open entrance: splash containment depends on the entrance layout and screen placement. Tray and drain inclusion is not established; budget separately. Despite milchglas in the old handle, the checked title and description specify clear glass. Search Walk-In Duschwand GWR70H and confirm the finish.

blocks.name: SONNI Duschkabine Eckeinstieg, 70×70cm / 185cm
blocks.badge: For a closing corner shower entrance
blocks.blurb: Choose 70*70cm / 185cm, SKU GCR70+GCR70+GCRF, for sliding corner access. Its displayed price was €257.99 EUR on November 26, 2026, with stock available in both saved variant records. The description specifies 5mm ESG to EN 12150, coated glass and chrome-finish aluminium profiles, with a 680–700mm adjustment range on each nominal 700mm side. The range offers 70/76/80/90/100/120cm sides and 185/195cm heights; combinations and prices vary. Ohne Duschtasse is explicit: the shower tray is excluded. Confirm the drain package separately. The trade-off is more moving hardware and profile cleaning than a fixed screen. Search Duschkabine Eckeinstieg Schiebetür with the exact size; do not assume the 195cm version costs the same or that the footprint equals the clear entrance width.

blocks.name: SONNI LED Badspiegel GLM04XL, 120×60cm
blocks.blurb: Choose GLM04XL for a broad, flat mirror rather than cupboard storage. Its displayed price was €149.99 EUR on November 26, 2026, with stock available in both saved variant records. The page lists 1200×600×35mm, 4mm mirror glass, IP44, three adjustable light colours, dimming, two touch controls and a clock/temperature display. Beschlagfrei describes the separately switched anti-fog function; it is not our steam-clearance test. A mounting set is listed. The trade-off is electrical preparation without concealed storage. Exact colour-temperature values, input voltage and plug-versus-hardwire connection were not verified in the checked specification. Have the electrician confirm the European 230V installation requirements and placement before ordering. Search LED Badspiegel GLM04XL 120x60, not an unspecified lookalike.

blocks.name: SONNI LED Spiegelschrank GTBC001T-1, three doors
blocks.badge: For recessed mirror storage above the basin
blocks.blurb: Choose GTBC001T-1 only if your wall can accept recessed storage. Its displayed price was €269.99 EUR on November 26, 2026, with stock available in both saved variant records. The current description calls it an Einbau-/Unterputz-Spiegelschrank, expressly not a conventional surface-mounted cabinet. It lists 105cm width, 65cm height, 13cm depth, stainless steel, three doors, 3mm mirror glass, IP44 and 9W LED lighting in cool, neutral and warm white. A covered shaver socket is described as unsuitable for hair dryers. Body and mirrors arrive separately for assembly. The trade-off is building a recess and arranging compliant electrics. Shelf count/adjustability, cabinet weight, fixing-load rating, exact input voltage and connection method were not verified. Obtain the installation drawing and shelf details before cutting the wall. Search LED Spiegelschrank Edelstahl 3türig GTBC001T-1.

blocks.name: SONNI Badheizkörper GTRSF1350W, 500×1314mm / ohne
blocks.badge: For towel warming after heat-source confirmation
blocks.blurb: Consider 500*1314mm / ohne, SKU GTRSF1350W, only after Sonni24 resolves its heating configuration. Its displayed price was €164.99 EUR on November 26, 2026, with stock available in both saved variant records. The page lists white RAL 9016 low-carbon SPCC steel and dimensions of 500×1314mm. The title says electric with thermostat and Heizstab, but the body describes hot-water heating and lists 555/634/770W against three sizes. It does not establish an electric element's inclusion or rating. The option selector labels ohne/Weiß/Chrom as Anschlussarmatur, a connection-fitting choice, not a verified electricity selector. The same 500×1314mm Chrom variant, GTRSF1350W+GBC, was €209.99 EUR and available. The trade-off is unresolved installation scope: confirm element, fluid, valves, connection spacing and heat-output conditions before payment. Do not buy it as a verified plug-in heater.

blocks.text: Glass: adjustment is not an extra opening allowance

The nominal 700mm partition fits 685–700mm including its profile, not 715mm. The corner's 700mm sides instead adjust to 680–700mm. Measure tiled installation lines, not unfinished masonry dimensions. Request a drawing if a lip, uneven wall or floor edge changes profile placement.

Nano coating is a published cleaning feature, not proof of maintenance-free glass. Nor does thicker glass establish water tightness: this 8mm open screen and 5mm sliding enclosure control different openings. The corner description contains generic tray-like language about an integrated slope, but explicitly says trays are not included. Do not let that wording turn an enclosure price into a complete drainage system.
Mirrors: settle the recess and electrical supply together

GLM04XL needs wall space; GTBC001T-1 needs a wall opening as well. Confirm recess depth, service access, structural support and door clearance from the cabinet's installation drawing. Its 13cm overall depth is not a verified cutting specification. Shelves pictured in a gallery do not establish their count, adjustment range or safe load. Include stored toiletries when discussing mounting loads with the installer.

Both pages publish IP44, but neither checked specification settles the exact mains input or whether a plug is supplied. European 230V planning is not evidence of 120V compatibility, and a travel adapter is not an installation assessment. Have the electrician confirm the supplied manual, permissible wet-zone position and required protection. The cabinet's shaver socket is expressly not for a hair dryer. Do not relocate wiring based on a product photograph.
Radiators: a Heizstab and a Mittelanschluss do different work

Heizstab means an electric heating element; Mittelanschluss means a central pipe connection. A connection block does not itself prove electric operation. For GTRSF1350W, ask whether the delivered unit is hydronic, electric-ready or supplied with an element and thermostat. Obtain connection centres, thread dimensions, filling instructions and any dual-fuel permissions rather than borrowing them from another radiator.

The ordered 500×1314mm size corresponds to the first of the published 555/634/770W figures, but the page does not give rating conditions or establish element wattage. We have no verified BTU figure, room-area claim, 230V element rating or IP44 rating for this radiator. Have the plumber assess output against the room's heat loss, and an electrician assess any proposed electric version. Confirm these details before installation costs make a return harder.
How we chose

We screened ten cached available listings and selected five non-overlapping jobs: open shower screening, closing corner access, illuminated reflection, recessed storage and towel warming. We matched the exact variants to displayed prices, HTML stock data and Shopify JSON. These are specification-led candidates, not measured winners. The radiator remains conditional because an available cart button does not resolve conflicting specifications.

Customer ratings are not a Duyan score; official photography is not our installation evidence. Our [ProtoArc workspace guide](/best/best-protoarc-ergonomic-gear) also starts with fit, but is not a bathroom safety source. Obtain model-specific installation advice.
Before you buy from Sonni24

**Germany/EU scope, not EU-wide approval:** confirm any destination beyond Germany. The storefront and contract language are German. Manual and support languages were not verified; confirm them before ordering. Prices are EUR; the saved blocks do not establish VAT/MwSt. inclusion. The Impressum names Sonni Sanitär GmbH, Kleinhülsen 6, 40721 Hilden, Germany. Confirm collection details: another policy gives number 12.

**Shipping costs conflict.** The shipping policy lists parcel delivery at €0.00 EUR. The separate Versand page lists parcel and Spedition freight at €10.00 EUR, express at €20.00 EUR, and an extra €10.00 EUR for shower enclosures below €199.00 EUR or oversized articles above an undefined weight. Do not add overlapping clauses yourself. Both pages mention a €60.00 EUR island surcharge; remote areas may cost more. Confirm the selected SKU/address total. Packstation delivery is excluded.

**Freight stops at the ground-floor door.** The policy says Haustür im Erdgeschoss, with no stairs, carrying inside or assembly. It does not expressly promise frei Bordsteinkante curb delivery. Arrange onward handling of glass and heavy fixtures. Tables suggest 2–3 days for parcels and three working days for freight, while Lieferung gives 3–15 working days. Do not book trades against a promised arrival date; the merchant itself advises waiting until receipt.

**Inspect before storage or fitting.** Photograph packaging, glass edges and missing hardware; retain goods and packaging while resolving a claim. The refund page requests damage reports within seven days, with seven working days used elsewhere. The terms explicitly say missed consumer damage reporting does not remove statutory rights. These requests are not a seven-day legal claim cutoff.

**Withdrawal is not free return freight.** The refund policy states the statutory 14-day Widerrufsrecht and return dispatch within 14 days after notice. Buyers pay direct change-of-mind return costs, estimated at approximately €30.00 EUR, not a guaranteed bulky-freight cap. Refunds include standard outbound shipping and are due within 14 days of notice, but may be withheld pending goods or dispatch proof. A separate Widerrufsrecht page says one month and 15-day return dispatch, with different contacts. Ask which instructions apply, keep evidence and act within the shorter period rather than relying on an unconfirmed extension. Defective-goods rights are separate.

items.q: Is Sonni24 a US bathroom store?
items.a: No. The checked seller is Sonni Sanitär GmbH in Hilden, Germany, with a German-language storefront and EUR prices. Germany is documented for delivery. Confirm other EU addresses directly; the cached policies do not establish a complete international destination list or US delivery.

items.q: Is the walk-in glass frosted because its handle says milchglas?
items.a: The checked title and description say Klarglas, meaning clear glass. The old handle is not a reliable finish specification. Confirm GWR70H, 70cm / 8mm, before ordering. Its nominal 700mm installed width adjusts inward to 685mm; height is 200cm.

items.q: Does the corner enclosure include a tray or drain?
items.a: The page explicitly excludes the shower tray: ohne Duschtasse. Confirm drain contents rather than reading generic slope language as a supplied tray. Budget for the tray or prepared floor, drainage and waterproofing. The selected 185cm-high enclosure uses 5mm ESG, not 6mm or the partition's 8mm.

items.q: Can I plug the LED mirror into a US outlet?
items.a: Do not assume so. GLM04XL lists IP44 and three light colours, but its checked specification does not establish exact input voltage or a supplied plug. Plan around European 230V installations and obtain the model's electrical instructions. We have not verified 120V compatibility, adapter suitability or hardwired-versus-plug connection.

items.q: Can the three-door mirror cabinet hang on the wall surface?
items.a: Its current description explicitly specifies recessed, flush installation and says it is not designed for conventional surface mounting. Obtain the recess drawing and load/fixing requirements. Stainless steel, IP44 and a shaver socket do not settle shelf capacity or structural support; the socket is not for hair dryers.

Not established. The headline advertises electric operation with thermostat/Heizstab, while the body describes hot water. Ohne and Chrom belong to the connection-fitting selector. Confirm the element, thermostat, filling and pipe requirements for GTRSF1350W. The published first-size 555W figure is not verified electric input wattage.

items.q: Are delivery and change-of-mind returns free?
items.a: Not reliably. Published parcel fees conflict between €0.00 EUR and €10.00 EUR, with freight and destination exceptions. Change-of-mind return costs fall to the buyer under the refund policy. Its approximate €30.00 EUR estimate is not a collection quote. The 14-day and one-month withdrawal pages also disagree; confirm instructions promptly.

items.q: Does the referral code guarantee a discount?
items.a: No. The verified code is NGUYENTHIDUYAN, but no coupon discount value was specified. Our dated EUR prices are displayed store observations, not affiliate savings or checkout guarantees. Search the exact variant after opening the storefront, then confirm tax treatment, shipping and the final amount before paying.
